title: AWS signs PPA for up to 960 MW from Talen's Susquehanna nuclear plant

sources.quote: Under the AWS PPA, AWS has minimum contractual power commitments that increase in 120 MW increments annually (or earlier, at AWS’s option), with a one-time option to either cap commitments at 480 MW or otherwise purchase, in continuing annual steps, up to 960 MW.

explain: Alongside buying the Cumulus data center campus in March 2024, AWS signed a fixed-price deal (initial term 18 years) to buy power directly from Talen's Susquehanna nuclear plant, ramping up to 960 MW. It was replaced in June 2025 by a larger 1,920 MW grid-connected PPA. Plant: Susquehanna Steam Electric Station, Pennsylvania.
